response.text: Article 15 of the GDPR gives a data subject the right to obtain from the controller confirmation whether their personal data are being processed and, if so, access to that personal data and information about the processing (for example: purposes, categories of data, recipients, retention periods, and the existence of automated decision‑making). It also entitles the data subject to obtain a copy of the personal data and other specific information set out in the Article. ([eur-lex.europa.eu](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?qid=1494678401079&uri=CELEX%3A32016R0679&utm_source=openai))
